final:
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("") == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(name) else ""

test_read_note_missing() uses fs =
  assert read_note("does_not_exist.txt") == ""
